_comment: Machine-readable known differences (verdict 已知差异). Read by wire_diff_<lang>.rs; no Markdown parsing. An entry applies only to a diff row whose fixture label AND leaf JSON path both match a scope item AND whose generated and serde values are both JSON numbers AND equal when compared as f64 (final conditions). phasesExcerpt is the authoritative in-repo copy of aimux-plan PHASES.md:307 (provenance only). KD-SWIFT-NUM-1 is planned and unmeasured: it is kept only if the post-install measurement confirms it. The every-ID-referenced check removes it otherwise.

entries.limitationSource: swift-corelibs-foundation / Foundation JSONDecoder: the public Decoder API exposes no raw number text, so JSONValue (Bool -> Int64 -> UInt64 -> Double) may decode integral floats (1.0, 1e3, -0.0) through the Int64 branch; serde_json::Value keeps them as f64.
